title: Atlas Enchants
description: AtlasEnchants brings an RPG-style custom enchantment system to Minecraft. It adds 22 unique enchantments spread across six rarity tiers, plus special crafting stations and items that let players discover, apply, remove, and upgrade enchantments.

title: DeathChest
description: Stores a player's items and XP in a protected chest on death, with holograms, particles, temporary owner protection, configurable expiry and public looting. Items are held virtually to avoid dupes.

title: Recycler.
description: Recycle unwanted items into valuable resources.

title: PlayerSettings

This Plugin gives the players on your server skills that they can level and earn EXP rewards every 10 levels in each skill.
